videos.t: Making The Mark 6 “Real” Part 1! #shorts #ironman #3dprinting
Battle Damaged Iron Man Mark 6 At C2E2! #3dprinting
DROiD DEPOT | A Galaxy's Edge Miniature
videos.desc:
Happy Star Wars day, May the 4th be with you! 
Here's a miniature I made for my Models and Minis class! 
This build was done mainly in pink foam, foam core board, cardboard, and 3d printed detail pieces (all of the droids and structures of back conveyor belt). This was built over a 13 week period and meticulously designed after the Disneyland Galaxy's Edge - I had some creative freedom since I was also merging some features of the concept art with the actual design of the building, as well as altering it so that it didn't look like a store. 

Thanks to Nikolai Zychowicz (z.clik on instagram) f
